name: TwoTrees TS2 20W
tagline: TwoTrees' popular TS2 platform — 20W open-frame with active community
tldr: The TS2 20W is one of TwoTrees' best-known laser lines — often compared to Ortur and Sculpfun at aggressive sale prices. Good for hobbyists who prioritize price and can tolerate less polished support than xTool.
mainObjective: Value 20W open-frame for engraving & light cutting on a budget

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cons: TS2 40W Max may be better value when on sale
beginnerNotes: Compare TS2 20W sale price against Ortur LM3 20W — often within $50. Pick Ortur for community; TS2 when the deal is significantly cheaper.
proTips: TwoTrees bundles (honeycomb + air assist) often beat buying parts separately — check official store bundles before checkout.
primaryUse: Budget 20W TwoTrees platform for hobby engraving and moderate thin-wood cutting.
